svg.title: airgap-lab architecture
svg.desc: Mac host running VirtualBox with four VMs on a host-only network: infra (NTP, registry, CA, internet via NAT), cp1 control plane, and workers w1 and w2, connected by a Flannel pod network.
svg.text: Air-gapped Kubernetes practice cluster · 4 VirtualBox VMs · Kubernetes v1.37.1 · status 2026-10-28
Pod network 10.244.0.0/16 · Flannel VXLAN overlay (flannel.1) · pod MTU 1450 · services 10.96.0.0/12
Flow: kubectl (cp1) → kube-apiserver → scheduler picks a node → kubelet starts the pod via containerd → image pulled from infra (registry.k8s.io / ghcr.io mirrors)
Snapshot "cluster-ok" on all four VMs = baseline for failure exercises · restore all VMs together
